name: TMS Contact Level 1 Code
definition: Level of urgency in contacting the terminal management system.

CRIT.name: Critical
CRIT.definition: Terminal management system has to be contacted before the next transaction.

ASAP.name: As Soon As Possible
ASAP.definition: Terminal management system has to be contacted as soon as possible (for example after reconciliation).

DTIM.name: Date Time
DTIM.definition: Terminal management system has to be contacted at the date and time provided.
